Fix PR: https://github.com/kubernetes/ingress-nginx/pull/14728

As is our policy, this announcement is being made along with the public release of the fix source code.

Release builds for v1.15.1, v1.14.5, and v1.13.9 are in progress. I will update the ticket when they are available.

Release builds have finished, and the patched versions are available from all the usual places.

Special thanks to @Gacko, @Stevenjin8, and @strongjz for their hustle to get this fix written, tested, and published before KubeCon. It has been a wonderful pleasure to work with you to give all ingress-nginx users the cleanest, safest final release we possibly can.
